integrity: All stated finite graph cardinalities and rational calculations have a stand-alone exhaustive exact integer checker; no independence or outside mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only deterministic IEEE binary16 roundTiesToEven, subnormals enabled, native rounded multiplication followed by subtraction, beta=3/2. No generalization to other precisions, compilers, operation orders or stochastic rounding. Published primary work contains related Float32 enumerations and sampled half-precision measures; equivalent hidden tables cannot be ruled out. Continuum comparison uses the classical real beta-map invariant density.
title: Exact binary16 cycle spectrum and long-time mean bias of the \(3/2\)-beta map
